name: Hibira Chat
subtitle: Answer website chats anywhere
description:
Hibira Chat is the mobile inbox for Hibira Live Chat. When a visitor writes on your website, your phone tells you right away, and you can reply from wherever you are.

• Shared inbox: see your team's open chats, take one in a tap, and reply in real time.
• Notifications: new chats, chats assigned to you and visitor replies arrive as push notifications. Tap one to open that chat.
• Ratings: see how customers rated each chat and spot unhappy customers right away.
• Automatic replies: easy questions are answered from your own Q&A, and the chat comes to your team when a person is needed.
• Sign in your way: a sign-in link sent to your work email, or your company's single sign-on.
• Seven languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

Hibira Chat needs a Hibira Live Chat workspace. The workspace owner sets it up at chat.hibira.io and invites the team. The free plan includes 2 agents.
keywords: live chat,customer support,shared inbox,helpdesk,website chat,customer service,agent,reply
promotionalText: Get notified the moment a visitor writes, reply from your phone, and see how customers rate each chat.
